name: apiCall
description: Calls a declared REST or GraphQL operation and returns its typed response.

typeParameters.name: I
typeParameters.description: The input object type the operation declares.

typeParameters.name: O
typeParameters.description: The response type the operation declares.

typeParameters.name: T
typeParameters.description: The type of each optimistic state value, checked per entry against its state path.

inputs.name: input
inputs.description: The operation's input: path, query and body values.

inputs.name: optimistic
inputs.description: State entries to set immediately and roll back if the call fails (ACT-007).
